prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel-art mascot sprite atlas for a live college football analytics graphic. Create ONE precisely aligned 4-column by 4-row sprite sheet, portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, 1024x1536 or larger. Sixteen equally sized cells, invisible grid. Each cell contains one different full-body friendly sports mascot in the SAME gray and ivory American football uniform, shoulder pads, pants and cleats, holding a brown football. Character heads maintain their natural species colors. Every character fully contained centered in its own cell, generous empty margins, no overlap. Clean retro 16-bit pixel art with crisp hard square pixels and black outlines, matching a 1990s desktop sports game. Uniform front is plain with no number or logos. Solid exact cream #f3eedc background throughout, no shadows outside sprites, no text, no labels, no borders, no actual grid lines. Read left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1. duck; 2. tiger; 3. bulldog; 4. eagle; 5. wildcat; 6. bear; 7. horse; 8. bull; 9. ram; 10. owl; 11. wolf; 12. rooster; 13. panther; 14. bison; 15. husky dog; 16. cardinal bird. Each character should have distinct instantly recognizable head and face and athletic mascot suit physique, friendly confident stance. The helmeted football player is a neutral anonymous athlete with face obscured. Respect exact order and exactly sixteen characters.
